name: PPT Live
description: AI-assisted PPT generation and editing: create an outline, generate slides, refine page content, preview, and export a shareable HTML deck.
permission_rationale: PPT Live stores only its own deck draft and uses the host AI client only when the user explicitly asks it to generate an outline, generate slides, or improve a selected slide.

ai_context.original_prompt: A built-in Live App for AI-assisted PPT generation, preview, and visual editing.
